SolNode254.value: Descend from Marie's Sanctuary (Dark Refractory, Deimos)

SolNode255.value: Descend from Lyon's Sanctuary (Dark Refractory, Deimos)

abilitylockout.desc: All Abilities are disabled until the squad kills 50 enemies.

acceleratedenemies.desc: Enemies deal -15% Damage and take +15% Damage but gain +15% Movement Speed, Attack Speed, and Fire Rate.

alchemicalshields.desc: 10% of enemies are equipped with an impervious Elemental Barrier that can only be destroyed by an Amphor of the corresponding element.

antiguard.desc: Warframe and ally Overguard gain reduced by 75%.

antimaterialweapons.desc: Rogue Culverins equip weapons that deal 5x Damage to Overguard and Necramechs.

arcadeautomata.desc: Enemy guns launch large, slow moving orbs instead of their usual ordnance.

armorless.desc: Casting an ability reduces armor by 10% for 10s.

artillerybeacons.desc: When killed, Scaldra troops drop artillery beacons that summon bombardments.

balloonfest.desc: Scaldra Harbingers are more numerous and attack and move more quickly.

chemicalnoise.desc: Drones fly above Flare, spraying them with Efervon gas.

competitionspillover.desc: Random negative penalties from Amir and Aoi's "Faceoff" mode will be applied throughout the mission.

contactdamage.desc: Gain 1 Puncture Status Effect every time you take damage.

contaminationzone.desc: The entire region deals Toxin damage over time, increasing the longer players remain.

decayingflesh.desc: Max health reduced each time health damage is taken

deflectors.desc: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.

disruptivesounds.desc: Flare creates a field that disrupts player abilities while draining energy to boost Flare's health. Flare slowly loses health when no players are in range.

doubletrouble.desc: Two Necramech Demolishers will attack any Conduit, but their health is reduced.

doubletroublelegacyte.desc: Two Legacytes spawn each round and twice as many captures are needed for success.

drainingresiduals.desc: Allies within 4m of slain enemies gain 25% Fire Rate at the cost of -50% Ammo Efficiency.

empblackhole.desc: As Rogue Arcocanids charge attacks, they pull Warframes towards them.

efervonfog.desc: Efervon gas blankets the level. Enemies may drop filters that can provide a temporary reprieve.

energystarved.desc: Lose 2 Energy per second for each enemy within 10 meters of you.

escalateimmediately.desc: Consequences of opening a Supply Cache are active from the start and will intensify if the Supply Cache is opened. Failure to open a Supply Cache doubles the kill count required to finish the mission.

exhaustion.desc: Lose 2 Energy per second for each enemy within 10 meters of you.

explosiveenergy.desc: Enemies drop Miasmites upon death that immediately rush Flare.

explosivesummer.desc: All supply crates are replaced with explosive barrels.

factionswarm_scaldra.desc: All enemies are replaced with Scaldra and move much faster.

factionswarm_techrot.desc: All enemies are replaced with Techrot and move much faster.

fallfog.desc: A fog limits vision across the mission zone.

fortifiedfoes.desc: Enemies take 90% less damage from non-Weak Point hits.

fragilenodes.desc: Enemies can target and destroy Conduits.

framecurse.desc: Activating an Ability inflicts 50 damage upon you.

gestatingtumors.desc: Techrot Tumors appear near Hell-Scrubbers, increasing the rate of life support decay with each active tumor.

growingincursion.desc: Fissures rip into the mission, causing the Enemy Level to go up by 1 every 10s. Destroy them to stop the level from increasing further.

harshwords.desc: Each Glyph inflicts a small amount of damage when collected.

heavywarfare.desc: Enemies take 95% less damage from non-heavy weapons. Enemies will drop heavy ammo packs and heavy weapon recall time reduced to 5s.

highscalinglegacyte.desc: Legacytes are more powerful with each generation but take longer to escape.

hostileovergrowth.desc: Within the underground, hostile overgrowths will attack if players stops moving.

hostilesecurity.desc: The Auricle and Vitreum take damage over time, collecting the required Vosphene Glyphs will halt the degradation and partially heal them.

infectedtechrot.desc: Techrot enemies are infused with Efervon and take damage over time. They explode when killed and leave behind deadly Efervon in their wake.

infinitetide.desc: The Fragmented Tide never stops attacking.

jadespring.desc: Jade Wisps haunt the region. If approached, they chase down the player responsible and transform into Jade Light beams.

knifestep.desc: Lose 2 Health when moving. Jumping pauses the effect.

lostintranslation.desc: The security system requires twice as many Vosphene Glyphs to activate.

miasmitehive.desc: Techrot Miasmites swarm out of the shadows throught the mission.

murmurincursion.desc: Murmur enemies join Scaldra and Techrot forces.

mutatedenemies.desc: As the Legacyte evolves other enemies present also gain new abilities.

operatorlockout.desc: Transference into Operator and Drifter is blocked.

oversensitive.desc: Duration of negative Status Effects is tripled

pointblank.desc: Enemies will only take damage if a player is within 15m of them.

quicksand.desc: Allies within 4m of slain enemies endure reduced Movement Speed and Parkour Velocity.

reinforcements.desc: Eximus units support The Fragmented Tide and its final form.

shieldedfoes.desc: All enemies have Overguard equal to 50% of their max health.

starvation.desc: Ammo restored by drops and gear is reduced 75%.

tankreinforcements.desc: Reinforcements will arrive during the fight.

tankstrongarmor.desc: Only Thermian RPGs can damage the tank. Reinforcements that carry Thermian RPGs will arrive during the fight

tanksupertoxic.desc: The tank has a Toxin aura, leaves Toxin trails, and its attacks all deal Toxin damage.

techrotconjunction.desc: Techrot enemies attempt to melee attack Hell-Scrubbers, bursting on contact and increasing scrubber contamination by 25%.

undersupplied.desc: Max ammo on all weapons reduced by 75%

unpoweredcapsules.desc: Life Support Towers only activate after 20 enemies have been killed within a 15m radius of them.

voidaberration.desc: Slow moving, immortal, Duviri Liminus drain health and energy from allies who get too close.

voidenergyoverload.desc: Using an Ability opens a Void Rift on top of you.

voidburst.desc: Slain enemies burts with Void energy.

volatilegrenades.desc: Amphors deal elemental damage while carried.

winterfrost.desc: Arctic Eximus globes have 30x their normal durability.

withering.desc: Pickups do not heal, and Health Orbs cannot be picked up.
